name: Creatify
summary: AI ad creation platform for image and video ads, with avatars, URL-to-video and ad analytics.
description: Creatify produces image and video ads with AI. Tools include URL-to-video, AI avatars, ad cloning and a creative agent, plus a competitor tracker and an ad library for research. Integrations cover an API, MCP and ad launching. Plans start at $15 per month ($10 billed yearly) for 55 credits, with Pro, Max and team tiers above it; a free plan was not confirmed.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: The official pricing page lists a Free plan with 10 credits a month. Standard is $15/month, or $10/month billed yearly.

howToUse.title: Open Creatify
howToUse.description: Go to Creatify and start a trial. Creatify produces image and video ads.

howToUse.title: Generate the ad
howToUse.description: Use URL-to-video, AI avatars, ad cloning or the creative agent to make the ad.
